hook_line: ROYAL ENFIELD POSTS RECORD FESTIVE SALES

hook_stat.sub: Motorcycles sold across September and October, a best-ever festive performance

stats.label: Motorcycles sold in October, up 7% from a year earlier
Jump in October exports, to 11,915 units
Motorcycles sold April to October, up 18% year-on-year

diaspora_bullets: The September-October festive total already passed last year's entire festive-season total before this season had closed
A limited Classic 650 edition of 125 units for India sold out in less than six minutes
news_summary: Royal Enfield sold 1,33,442 motorcycles in October, up 7 per cent, taking September-October festive sales to a record 2,67,400 units as exports jumped 47 per cent.
payoff: This was Royal Enfield's best-ever festive performance.
